build-bin.//: Override of the `build-bin` target inferred by @nx/js/typescript's second registration (configName tsconfig.build-bin.json) — see that registration in nx.json for why the inferred `tsc --build tsconfig.build-bin.json` cannot run in this workspace. Compiles bin/cli.ts's WHOLE reachable graph (src/** AND bin/*, per tsconfig.lib.json's existing include list) in one tsc pass, mirroring source structure under dist/ so dist/bin/cli.js's `require('../src/api.js')` resolves to the ALSO-emitted dist/src/api.js. dependsOn:[build] is load-bearing: vite's build.emptyOutDir wipes dist/ on every run, so this MUST run after build (tsc is additive, never empties outDir) never before/parallel.
build-bin.//clean: Additive by construction: this command never empties dist/, so the retired executor's `clean: false` is preserved. That was load-bearing — build-bin's output dir is the SAME entrypoint/dispatch-cli/dist that `build` (vite) just populated with index.js/index.mjs/index.d.ts/api.d.ts/lib, so a clean run would WIPE those files the instant it starts (verified empirically while authoring the original fix: build's output vanished entirely after build-bin ran on top of it).
build-bin.//outputs: Narrower than build's outputs ({projectRoot}/dist = the whole dir) so each target's own Nx cache-restore only ever touches the subtree it actually owns, never the sibling target's files.

assets.//: @adhd/nx-assets:copy is inferred by tools/nx-plugins/assets/plugin.js with dependsOn:["build"] only. Now that package.json declares a `bin` field pointing at dist/bin/cli.js, this target's chmod-the-bin-file step needs that file to exist first — overridden here (dependsOn only; executor/cache still come from the inferred target) to add build-bin.

dist-manifest.//: @adhd/nx-build:manifest is inferred with dependsOn:["build","assets"]. Rebases package.json (including the new `bin` field) against dist/ — needs build-bin so dist/bin/cli.js exists before the rebase runs.

verify-dist-load.//: @adhd/nx-build:verify is inferred with dependsOn:["build","dist-manifest"]. It now resolves the `bin` entry declared in package.json against dist/bin/cli.js — needs build-bin, else it fails with 'file declared in package.json but missing from dist' (verified empirically while authoring this fix).

test.//: Override of the inferred `test` target (dependsOn only; executor/cache/outputs come from inference). cli-smoke.spec.ts drives the GENERATED CLI at dist/entrypoint/dispatch-cli/cli/cli.ts and the compiled bin at dist/bin/cli.js, so it needs `generate-cli` and `build-bin`. targetDefaults.test's `^build` builds only dependencies; an explicit dependsOn replaces the targetDefault, so `lint`/`^build` are repeated.
